title: What If You Could See WiFi?
description:
What if you woke up tomorrow and could actually SEE WiFi? Glowing routers, see-through walls, your own WiFi shadow, a cell tower blazing like a lighthouse... and the afterglow of the Big Bang across the whole sky. Here's the real science of seeing the invisible light you've been living in your whole life. And why your WiFi might be able to see you too.

Would you turn on WiFi vision for a day? Tell me in the comments 👇
